title: Figure 5: SEM of Sandia micro-motor gears, with Figure 4 BioMEMS motor principle diagram
description: Scanning electron micrograph of interlocking perforated micro-gears labeled "A" and "B" with a toothed rack, scale bar text "6301F 20KV ... 21mm"; the caption reads "Figure 5. Close-Up Views of the Micro-Motor Gears (Sandia National Labs)." Above it, Figure 4, "Illustration of the Basic Physical Principle of the BioMEMS Motor," is a line diagram of a sliding shaft (2) between two combs (1) and (3) with applied voltage V, gap d, x/y axes and curved pink field arrows. Text describes Sandia's SUMMiT V five-layer polysilicon fabrication process.
